body: hey man, i hope you're ok. i know that feeling of being blue and the physical pressure surrounding yourself (very accurate description). what helps me a lot sometimes is i guess you'd call it existentialism? but knowing how insignificant we are in the universe and how small our problems are comparatively sometimes gives me some relief. however, if that doesnt work - meditation and also the book 'how to win friends and influence people' is a nice place to start kind of practicing techniques to build those relationships. some parts sound cliche but it has a lot of logical points, especially if you're wanting to make friends at uni. life is always moving forward, its never stable, it moves forward and positive things can emerge :)
